title: Local DeepSeek dialogue
description: Inspect conversational context, streamed output and the effect of changing one generation setting.
lesson: The original app stores a per-session list, calls Ollama synchronously inside an async handler and replays the result. Separate UI state from the bounded provider request and only commit completed turns.
experiment: Introduce a fact, ask a follow-up, then repeat the follow-up in another tab. Confirm context continuity within one tab and isolation across tabs.
starter: For this conversation, the fictional project code is MAPLE-17. What evidence would you need to verify that code outside this conversation?
pitfall: A fluent follow-up can come from supplied history rather than persistent memory. Interrupted or failed turns should not silently become successful history.
